name: Game, Flip, Flop
description: Game, Flip, Flop is a high-stakes variation of the American Rummy game 'Tunk' (or Tonk). Originating in Dayton, Ohio, it is famous for its three distinct betting pots: 'Game', 'Flip', and 'Flop'. While the core gameplay follows standard Rummy melding rules, the 'Flip' and 'Flop' pots introduce a side-betting element based entirely on having the lowest cards of specific suits dealt in your initial hand. It is a fast-paced gambling game where players can win pots without even playing a card.

content.text: Game, Flip, Flop is a high-stakes variation of the American Rummy game 'Tunk' (or Tonk). Originating in Dayton, Ohio, it is famous for its three distinct betting pots: 'Game', 'Flip', and 'Flop'. While the core gameplay follows standard Rummy melding rules, the 'Flip' and 'Flop' pots introduce a side-betting element based entirely on having the lowest cards of specific suits dealt in your initial hand. It is a fast-paced gambling game where players can win pots without even playing a card.

The game was documented by Chad Shumate as a local specialty of Dayton, Ohio. Its roots lie in the African-American card tradition of 'Tunk' (Tonk), which was widely played by soldiers and jazz musicians in the mid-20th century.
Deal 5 cards to each player. turn the next card (Dealer's last card) FACE-UP. This is the FLIP CARD.
